name: arli-discovery
description: ARLI discovery: an agent that matches on declared intent without an index holder. Ships the A2A surface to a model runtime as MCP tools.

tools.name: agent_card
tools.description: Calls agent/card on the ARLI discovery agent. Arguments are passed to the engine unchanged. A refusal keeps the engine's rejection code instead of a generic error.

surface.rule: generated from the engine surface, never hand-written

limitations: The plugin runs the MCP binding as a local process; it holds no engine logic of its own.
Features never leave the agent: the plugin cannot read raw feature values.
Matching is not a search: a smaller intersection is a smaller answer, not a worse one.
The command names the console script the package installs; where scripts are not installed, use the fallback module form instead.
